method: Read-only TypeScript compiler AST under src, excluding src/api, test/spec files, src/test and declaration files. Routes from JSX Route in App.tsx; callback attributes/mutation invocations/nav links are static candidates, not unique visible buttons. No browser/API/backend/DB operations or app changes.
limits: JSX spreads and runtime-produced controls may hide more callbacks.
Component declarations are PascalCase functions/arrows, not every memo/forwardRef/HOC export.
Source callbacks can overlap with mutation invocations and are not counts of unique visible buttons.
Navigation/query entries can include false positives; no type resolution or runtime route exercise.
Only JSX Route declarations in App.tsx were inventoried as routes; dynamic state/tab/dialog subviews are represented by source action/navigation candidates.
No individual source action receives a functional passed status without its own browser execution evidence.
Four public HTML documents and hosting rewrites are listed separately from React routes. Host rewrites with status 200 are rewrites, not redirects.
Controls include JSX occurrences with no local callback. Presence, visibility, inherited handlers/slots and actual behavior must be verified through the frontend.
